sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the ship-owned frameProfileType and plasticCollapseMechanism constraints and the applicable-member/load-case formula checks. Remove gs:SideMemberOrientationI2_031Shape: it incorrectly makes transverseFrameOrientation=true mandatory for every side-structure member, whereas only side members explicitly selected as transverse are applicable; missing side orientation must not select that member or be converted into a universal side-member obligation. Also add the declared COMPLETE formula operand nltl:patchLoad on its authoritative owner ship, with its QUDT QuantityValue decimal numeric value and canonical KiloN unit; do not relocate it to a member or load case.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType
Semantic validator feedback: Add the COMPLETE dependency-contract relationship nltl:frameProfileType on its authoritative owner ship and enforce its required role; do not place it on a structural member or load case. Retain the existing ship-to-member/load-case paths and per-member comparison.

Retain the now-correct ship-owned nltl:frameProfileType constraint. Repair applicability so that unrelated structural members are not forced to be bottom or side members: constrain the plastic-strength/load-case/comparison requirements only for members selected as bottom, or as side with explicit nltl:transverseFrameOrientation true; do not make all members satisfy the current three-way sh:or classification. Preserve failure for a side member whose required orientation-selection evidence is missing rather than allowing it through a non-applicable branch. Also implement the COMPLETE formula definition by requiring the supplied ship-owned nltl:plasticCollapseMechanism evidence with its canonical xsd:string datatype, in addition to the tolerance-based equality of member-owned plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad.

Retain the ship-owned frameProfileType and plasticCollapseMechanism constraints and the applicable-member/load-case formula checks. Remove gs:SideMemberOrientationI2_031Shape: it incorrectly makes transverseFrameOrientation=true mandatory for every side-structure member, whereas only side members explicitly selected as transverse are applicable; missing side orientation must not select that member or be converted into a universal side-member obligation. Also add the declared COMPLETE formula operand nltl:patchLoad on its authoritative owner ship, with its QUDT QuantityValue decimal numeric value and canonical KiloN unit; do not relocate it to a member or load case.
